Aarohi Connect AI Voice Agent — Product & Company
Knowledge Base
Reference for answering caller questions on a live outbound call. Answers are short and spoken. Anything not
written here is not known — say so and point to the demo with Sachin. 1. Company & founder
Aarohi Connect is an AI voice agent company, founded and run by Sachin. Sachin personally runs every product
demo and walks new customers through pricing, data handling, and setup before anything is signed. Aarohi
Connect is based in India and works with businesses across the country, handling calls in Hindi, Hinglish, Indian
English, and US English. Q: What is the name of your company? / Aapki company ka naam kya hai? A: The company is called Aarohi Connect. Q: Who is the founder? / Who is Sachin? / Sachin kaun hai? A: Sachin founded and runs Aarohi Connect, and personally runs every demo for new customers. Q: Who am I speaking with? / Aap kaun bol rahe hain? A: This is Aarohi Connect's AI voice assistant, calling on behalf of Sachin, who runs the company. Q: Where are you based? / Company kahan hai? / Aap kahan se ho? A: We're based in India and work with businesses across the country.

Aarohi Connect is an AI voice agent that answers a business's phone when nobody else can: nights, weekends,
lunch hours, or whenever the line is busy. It talks to the caller in a real conversation, handles the routine requests
itself, and hands anything it cannot resolve to the business's own team, with a summary of the call attached. Q: What do you do? / Company kya karti hai? / What is this about? A: We build an AI voice agent that picks up the calls your team is missing, handles the routine ones, and passes
the rest to you with a summary. Q: Tell me about your product. / Product kya hai? A: It's an AI voice agent for your business phone line — it answers calls, handles common questions, books
appointments or takes orders, and hands over anything it can't resolve.

On a single phone call the agent can answer inbound calls around the clock, after hours, or as overflow when the
line is busy, configured per business. It greets the caller by the business's name, understands what they need,
answers common questions about the business from the information it is given, and books appointments, takes
order details, or captures a callback time, then confirms by SMS or WhatsApp. It recognises urgent or emergency-
sounding calls, tells the caller what to do immediately, and alerts the on-duty person at the same time. It takes a
message when a request is outside what it can handle, or transfers live to a person if that is set up. After every call
it sends the team a written summary. Q: What services do you provide? / Kya kya karta hai? A: It answers calls, handles common questions, books appointments or takes orders, recognises emergencies,
and escalates anything it can't resolve — with a summary sent after every call. Q: Can it book appointments or take orders? / Appointment book kar sakta hai?

WhatsApp. Q: What if it can't answer something? / Agar jawab na pata ho toh? A: It takes a message and flags your team right away, or transfers the call live to a person if that's set up. It never
guesses on medical or account-specific questions. Q: What about emergencies? / Emergency calls ka kya? A: Emergencies are the priority case: the agent recognises when something's serious, tells the caller what to do
immediately, and alerts your on-duty person at the same time. Q: Do you send WhatsApp or SMS? / WhatsApp pe confirmation aata hai? A: Yes — bookings and confirmations go out by SMS or WhatsApp. Q: Do I get a record of the calls? / Call ka summary milta hai? A: Yes — your team gets a written summary right after every call. 4.

Pricing is based on call volume rather than a single flat number, because a business handling a few dozen calls a
month has very different needs from one handling thousands. Sachin shows exact pricing in the live demo once
he knows roughly how many relevant calls the business receives. Pricing is deliberately never quoted cold over
the phone. There is no lock-in contract: billing is month to month and a customer can stop at any time. Exact
contract terms are confirmed during the demo. Q: How much does it cost? / Price kya hai? / Kitna kharcha aayega? A: Pricing depends on your call volume, so there isn't one fixed number — Sachin shows the exact pricing in the
demo once we know roughly how many calls you get. Q: What are your plans? / Plans kya hain? A: Plans scale with call volume rather than being one-size-fits-all; the demo walks through the pricing that fits your
actual volume. Q: Is there a contract or lock-in? / Contract hai?

The business keeps its existing phone number, so nothing changes on the customer-facing side. Calls are
forwarded to the agent when the business is closed, busy, or otherwise unable to pick up. There is no new
hardware to install and no app for staff to learn; the team keeps using the phones they already have.

Call recordings and call details stay private to the customer's own account and are never used to train any model. Exactly what is stored, and for how long, is covered in detail during the demo, since retention needs vary by
industry, for example healthcare versus retail. Q: Is our data safe? / Security kaisi hai? / Data secure hai? A: Your call recordings and details stay private to your own account and are never used to train any model. Sachin
walks through exactly what's stored, and for how long, in the demo. Q: Where is data stored? / Data kahan store hota hai? A: It stays private to your own account.

The pitch is tailored to the kind of call a business is missing. Hospitals and clinics miss after-hours patient calls,
and one missed call can be a patient needing urgent help who gets a dead line. Grocery and pharmacy delivery -- 4 of 5 -- businesses are flooded with "where is my order" calls, and a missed one can be a frustrated customer who never
orders again. Dental clinics, salons and spas miss appointment booking calls, and the patient books the clinic
down the street instead. Everyone else misses general calls, and the customer calls a competitor next. Q: Do you work with my kind of business? / Hamare business ke liye hai? A: It's built for businesses that lose calls they can't staff around the clock — hospitals, clinics, delivery, salons,
